<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="Bf7a1hvadIKGkKtQ9NHV"> <mxGraphModel dx="1791" dy="964" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam style strictuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

' --- Base Class ---
class User {
 - userID: String
 - name: String
 - email: String
 - role: String
 + login(): boolean
 + logout(): void
}

' --- Inherited Role Classes ---
class Director {
 + viewDashboard(): void
}

class Distributor {
 + uploadInvoice(image: File): void
 + updateLocation(gps: String): void
}

class StockManager {
 + updateStock(productID: String, qty: int): void
 + configureThresholds(): void
}

class Accountant {
 + approveInvoice(invoiceID: String): void
 + viewLedger(): void
}

class Admin {
 + manageRoles(userID: String, newRole: String): void
 + triggerBackup(): void
}

' Set Inheritance (User is the parent)
User <|-- Director
User <|-- Distributor
User <|-- StockManager
User <|-- Accountant
User <|-- Admin

' --- Core Entity Classes ---
class Product {
 - productID: String
 - name: String
 - thresholdQuantity: int
 - currentStock: int
 + updateQuantity(amount: int): void
 + checkLowStock(): boolean
}

class Invoice {
 - invoiceID: String
 - imageURL: String
 - totalAmount: double
 - OCRConfidence: double
 - status: String
 + extractData(): void
 + validateData(): boolean
}

class DeliveryRoute {
 - routeID: String
 - currentGPS: String
 - status: String
 + startRoute(): void
 + endRoute(): void
 + logLocation(gps: String): void
}

class Alert {
 - alertID: String
 - type: String
 - message: String
 - timestamp: Date
 + triggerSMS(contact: String): boolean
 + logAlert(): void
}

' --- Relationships / Associations ---
Distributor \"1\" -- \"*\" DeliveryRoute : is assigned >
Distributor \"1\" -- \"*\" Invoice : uploads >
Accountant \"1\" -- \"*\" Invoice : reviews >
StockManager \"1\" -- \"*\" Product : manages >
Product \"1\" -- \"*\" Alert : triggers >

@enduml",
